value: **Direct Callouts & Context**: "Through analysis of nine high school teachers’ 1,363 asynchronous forum posts and 220 minutes of synchronous sessions, we identified complementary pathways: asynchronous forums supported knowledge building through archived threads and peer resource sharing, while synchronous sessions facilitated real- time collective sensemaking and expert scaffolding." | "Phase 2 was synchronous synthesis through expert scaffolding and peer collaboration." | "When teachers expressed instructional challenges asynchronously, facilitators addressed these in real -time with conceptual scaffolding."
